children: Nomu-listed Hamad Mohammed Bin Saedan Real Estate has signed Shariah-compliant credit facilities agreement with Alinma Bank worth SAR 46.72 million ($12.4 million).
The facility carries a tenure of 13 years, and will be used to finance the company's working capital requirements.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Saudi’s Hamad Bin Saedan Real Estate secures $12.4mln facility
